provenance: Every finished engine v3 turn with real credits (one turn_completion summary) and context_usage samples under /var/tmp/konductor-cx-1h/runs and /var/tmp/konductor-standard-v2/runs (the STANDARD study, 2026-11-22 to 2026-11-25, and the cx-carddemo runs of 2026-11-26). A conversation run gives one sample per stream-N.jsonl. Censored runs and v2 streams are left out.
method: pct is the sum of usagePercentage over every context_usage event of the turn, the same sum credit-watch.js keeps (each value appears twice in a v3 stream; the fit includes that). Real spend is bounded by two lines: slopeCap x pct (slopeCap = the largest credits/pct ratio seen, rounded up), which binds on short turns, and intercept + slope x pct, which binds on long ones. slope is the value in 0.0300..0.0800 (step 0.0001) that makes the worst overestimate on turns of at least 400 points smallest; intercept is then the smallest value that covers every sample, rounded up. The estimate is margin x the smaller line, so it sits above every sample by at least the margin.
